chunks: I would even wish that the heads of my companions were struck with whips until they acquire religious understanding.

key_terms.لوددت: hyperbolic wish expressing the Imam's intense desire; the conditional form underscores the urgency of the teaching
key_terms.يتفقهوا: fiqh (religious understanding/jurisprudence) — the verb form means to deeply comprehend religion, not merely to know surface facts

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the importance of religious understanding?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) expresses a striking hyperbolic statement about his intense desire that his followers acquire deep religious understanding (fiqh). The Imam uses the dramatic image of whipping to convey the urgency and supreme importance he places on religious learning — it is so vital that even physical hardship would be preferable to ignorance. This saying reflects the Imam's pastoral concern for his companions in a time when access to authentic religious knowledge was contested and suppressed by the Abbasid authorities.
